mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO md_source_product (source, product_id, product_name, product_group, enabled) VALUES
(#{it.source}, #{it.productId}, #{it.productName}, #{it.productGroup}, IFNULL(#{it.enabled}, 1))
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_name = VALUES(product_name), product_group = VALUES(product_group), enabled = VALUES(enabled), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, product_id, product_name, product_group, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM md_source_product WHERE source = #{source} ORDER BY product_id
